title: Topic 21
japanese_text: 学校の<u>任意</u>の課外活動で、<u>あえて</u>今までしたことのない茶道に挑戦した。いつも食べ物を口に<u>押し込んで</u>早食いをする私にとって、お抹茶や茶菓子のいただき方など、細かい<u>作法</u>を覚えるのは大変だったが、有意義な時間を過ごせたと思う。
english_translation: In an extracurricular activity option at school, I ventured to try the tea ceremony, something I had never done before. As someone who always shovels food into my mouth and eats quickly, it was difficult for me to remember the detailed etiquette of how to partake of matcha and tea cakes, but I think the time was meaningful.
